# Hista Digital

> Hista Digital is a recruiting agency based in St. Petersburg, Florida (USA). It finds skilled workers for trade businesses (plumbing and heating, electrical, renovation, industry) internationally, using motive-based recruiting campaigns. Operated by Hista Digital LLC, 7901 4th St N, Suite 300, St. Petersburg, FL 33702, USA (Florida Document Number L24000021107). Managing directors: Szymon "Maks" Lebek and Benedikt Klosa. Founded 2021.
